keep_or_promote_if: Beats the closing-line benchmark out of sample with a bootstrap lower bound above zero after 300 settled bets over 3 seasons; official designation changes precede the line move
demote_to_paper_if: Designation changes do not precede line moves in the test seasons; or the lower bound stays below zero at 300 bets

keep_or_promote_if: Fade side beats the closing line after controlling for the market move with multiplicity-adjusted p below 0.10
demote_to_paper_if: Actual-minus-Pythagorean gap has no predictive sign in the holdout season

keep_or_promote_if: Under result beats the closing total where an official report lists the starter Out; effect survives the inactive-list join
demote_to_paper_if: Effect disappears once the official designation is joined with the inactive list

keep_or_promote_if: Same sign in at least 2 holdout seasons with at least 100 games per season
demote_to_paper_if: Opposite sign in a holdout season; or the feature is found to use the game result (leakage)

keep_or_promote_if: Stack beats a random-pick control over at least 300 settled legs and a directly validated joint probability exists
demote_to_paper_if: No directly validated joint probability; the stack is priced as a product of marginals

keep_or_promote_if: Directly validated joint probability exceeds the operator-implied probability with documented void and push rules
demote_to_paper_if: Joint probability is only a product of marginals; dependence unmodelled (never ranked)

keep_or_promote_if: Exposure cap across correlated games holds and CLV stays positive after the cap
demote_to_paper_if: Simultaneous exposure exceeds the cap in any week

keep_or_promote_if: Rest-day effect from published schedule facts only predicts the margin residual out of sample
demote_to_paper_if: No holdout effect; or the rest variable uses anything other than published schedule facts

keep_or_promote_if: Lines move before official news time-stamps more often than after; measured on timestamped prices
demote_to_paper_if: Price timestamps missing or from a non-official source (price policy Q-01 unresolved)

keep_or_promote_if: Cross-fitted Brier skill against the naive baseline is above zero with a lower bound above zero
demote_to_paper_if: Skill below zero in any holdout season

keep_or_promote_if: Net-of-vig edge survives the cost model at the proposed stake
demote_to_paper_if: Edge disappears at stake sizes above the breakeven in the cost model

keep_or_promote_if: Growth stays positive under the haircut in every holdout season
demote_to_paper_if: Any holdout drawdown beyond the pre-registered limit in the demotion rule
